race.description: Komplete Laundry Solutions Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: HELLISH CHARM (7) Hellbent filly who earns top billing on debut after winning a trial at Beaumont (Newcastle), and the Ciaron Maher stable profile gives her a strong platform for a first-start performance. She was a $150,000 yearling purchase and Regan Bayliss has a strong record at this track. Well drawn and expected to play a leading role. MY QUEEN (8) resumes. Brings the best exposed run, having finished fourth in an Open at Muswellbrook after racing wide throughout last March. Primed with the two trials, including the latest second at Beaumont (Newcastle) over 800m.  Top three contender. BARROW POWER (5) resumes after having mixed luck in her first campaign. Stalked the speed on debut when second at Beaumont (Newcastle) last March. Trialled well and the claim keeps her in the mix. OAKFIELD MEXICO (3) has trialled twice, including a close third at Gosford, and the Kris Lees-Aaron Bullock combination gives him enough grounding to be considered a genuine placing chance. Keep safe.
